answer: Every new agent locks a refundable 300 POA bond for 100 days before paid work, so one fake identity costs 300 POA no farm can split. Its first jobs go on a public cedar registry buyers read before paying, so copied history shows at once. Pay waits in a haven escrow until the paying client signs off on the finished job. Three auditors drawn by lot replay one job a month against a marble record of receipts, and a forged receipt burns the bond and bars the key for a year.
